Internally packing columns, I regenerated the entire multiplication operation by recording the images of all 16 vectors under each endomorphism. Applying each polynomial on the four basis vectors and adding the two summands by XOR gave 5317 tripotents, 316 square-zero matrices, 1680172 ordered pairs and all 25 exact histogram entries. Independent conjugation orbits generated by elementary transvections cover all 65536 matrices exactly once and match the 34 packaged class sizes and the fiber on every orbit member. The nullities of f(A)^j also check the CSV's labelled primary partitions. The four claimed extremal classes matched, including r=3 on the 1120-element 0_2 plus irreducible quadratic class and r=162 on the 120 rank-three idempotents. Structurally, im(N) lies in ker(N), giving the rank counts 1,105,210; the coprime factors x and (x+1)^2 of x^3-x give the stated split for tripotents and the cardinality check. The endpoint identities follow from T=N at zero and (I+N)^2=I at the identity. Replay: python3 /workspace/audit_evidence/matrix.py <frozen class_table.csv>. value.rationale: This is a natural quantitative refinement of the tripotent-plus-square-zero existence problem in the order immediately after the cubic obstruction. It tells researchers exactly how nonunique such presentations can be and which input types force exceptionally small or large fibers; the unique nonzero-minimizing and nonidentity-maximizing types are not accessible from positivity. The complete similarity-class data have a clearer use than an isolated matrix example or an arbitrary cut of the search space. No general-dimension counting law is inferred.
